requirement:
Each assessment MUST have a separate JSON usage record under
`<state-root>/authoring/usage/<run-id>.json` using
{cite}`requirements.configuration.state_location`.
It MUST identify its format version, run, project root, subject kind and full
name, start time, backend and model when known, end time when finished, outcome,
accepted determination kind (`true`, `false`, or `FIXME`) when present, and
whether evidence was written. It MUST record the selected output destination in
`evidence_output` as `file` or `stdout`; a successful write to either destination
MUST set `evidence_written` to true. Usage recording MUST remain outside the
project in stdout mode. FIXME entry text MUST NOT be stored in usage records.
Failed, cancelled, or unfinished
runs MUST remain distinguishable from completed judgments. Records MUST persist
for later review without storing source text, prompts, responses, or rationale.
rationale:
I judge the marked tests adequate for `requirements.authoring.usage_storage`. I did not request any implementation source. Each obligation maps to tests and assertions as follows.

- **Location and one record per run.**
  - `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[usage_record_identifies_its_run_and_unusable_state_is_reported]` reads `<state>/habeas/authoring/usage/`. It asserts the file is named `<run_id>.json` and that a second `--force` run adds a second file. The first file stays byte-identical.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[citation_reviews_are_confirmed_with_fresh_targeted_conversations]` and `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[confirm_runs_a_second_assessment_with_its_own_usage_record]` check that separate assessments get separate records with distinct `run_id` values and subjects.
  - The batch tests check one record per assessment (6 for 6 subjects).
- **Fields.** `usage_record_identifies_its_run_and_unusable_state_is_reported` asserts these fields:
  - `version` (1), `run_id`, `project_root` (the canonical path), `subject`, `subject_kind`, `backend` and `model`.
  - `evidence_output`, `start_time_ms` and `end_time_ms`, with start no later than end.
  - `authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file` checks `model` from a workspace configuration.
  - `usage_subject_kind_is_known_before_sources_are_prepared` and `usage_record_of_an_early_failure_identifies_its_subject_kind` check `subject_kind` for all four kinds and for an early failure.
- **Outcome and determination kind.**
  - `false_is_a_completed_assessment` asserts `determination` is `"false"`.
  - `stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files` asserts `true`, `false` and `FIXME` across its cases.
  - `ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free` asserts `FIXME`.
  - `missing_duplicate_and_invalid_submissions_preserve_existing_evidence` asserts the determination is null when the submission was not accepted.
- **`evidence_output` and `evidence_written`.**
  - `stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files` asserts `evidence_output == "stdout"` and `evidence_written == true`.
  - `missing_duplicate_and_invalid_submissions_preserve_existing_evidence` covers both destinations with `evidence_written == false` on failure.
  - `failed_evidence_write_keeps_the_accepted_judgment_in_usage` checks that a failed write leaves the determination kind but `evidence_written == false`.
  - The batch tests assert `evidence_written == true` for completed file-mode runs.
  - `live_bedrock_authoring` also asserts the stdout case.
- **Outside the project in stdout mode.** `usage_state_inside_the_project_is_refused_before_creating_it` runs both default and `--stdout`. It points the state home inside the project and asserts a refusal, empty stdout, and that the directory is never created.
- **No FIXME entry text.** `ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free` asserts the serialized usage lacks `#125`, and the determination there is `FIXME`.
- **Failed, cancelled and unfinished are distinguishable.**
  - `cancelled_request_persists_elapsed_time_and_incomplete_totals` checks the initial `unfinished` outcome with a null end time, then `cancelled` with an end time.
  - `failed_persistence_records_failure_or_cancellation_and_retains_the_cause` checks `failed` versus `cancelled`, `evidence_written == false`, and a null determination.
  - `a_denied_mandatory_input_aborts_only_its_assessment` and `failed_assessment_keeps_other_results_and_reports_failure` check `failed` records alongside `completed` ones.
- **No source text, prompts, responses or rationale.** These tests assert absence of private strings in the serialized record:
  - `input_metadata_counts_components_and_reads_without_persisting_source` (source, requirement, definition and builtin text, file names and item names).
  - `tool_outcomes_are_distinct_and_unknown_names_do_not_leak_model_text`.
  - `ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free` (requirement, definition, source and rationale text, and the credential).
  - `authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file` (the credential).
- **Cited `requirements.configuration.state_location`.** The tests cover applying it to this feature. They check the XDG state home layout, persistence across invocations, and reporting a failure (non-zero exit, stderr message, no stdout) when the location cannot be created or determined. They also check that failed runs leave the existing evidence intact. The Windows `LOCALAPPDATA` branch is only exercised as a refused in-project path. That is part of the cited requirement, whose own tests are not reassessed here.

I found no obligation of the subject without a test that asserts its outcome.

text: :::{req} usage_storage
Each assessment MUST have a separate JSON usage record under
`<state-root>/authoring/usage/<run-id>.json` using
{cite}`requirements.configuration.state_location`.
It MUST identify its format version, run, project root, subject kind and full
name, start time, backend and model when known, end time when finished, outcome,
accepted determination kind (`true`, `false`, or `FIXME`) when present, and
whether evidence was written. It MUST record the selected output destination in
`evidence_output` as `file` or `stdout`; a successful write to either destination
MUST set `evidence_written` to true. Usage recording MUST remain outside the
project in stdout mode. FIXME entry text MUST NOT be stored in usage records.
Failed, cancelled, or unfinished
runs MUST remain distinguishable from completed judgments. Records MUST persist
for later review without storing source text, prompts, responses, or rationale.
:::{req} state_location
Habeas MUST store persistent per-user activity state under
`$XDG_STATE_HOME/habeas` on Unix when XDG_STATE_HOME is an absolute, nonempty path,
otherwise under `$HOME/.local/state/habeas`. On Windows it MUST use
`%LOCALAPPDATA%/habeas/state`. `HOME` and `LOCALAPPDATA` MUST likewise be
absolute, nonempty paths to be used. Features MUST use a named subdirectory under that
state root and document their record formats and locations.
State MUST persist across invocations and MUST NOT be stored in the project
repository, the configuration file, or a disposable cache directory. Habeas MUST
create the required directories when recording state. If it cannot determine or
write the state location, the operation requiring that state MUST report the
failure and MUST NOT claim that its history was recorded.
